conviction_note: Near non-result: the company's own guide arithmetic (FY robotaxi revenue >3.5x 2025 = >=$58M against $20.7M in H1, management 'confident of exceeding') points to a Q3 total around $40-41M against a two-analyst ~$39M bar, but this name has sold revenue beats (Q4'25 -13.6%, Q2'26 beat then -42% to mid-Nov), the swing item is the unreported fleet count against a 3,500 year-end target, and the stock sits at a 52-week low with calls bid, so p_up 52 on an abs move of 12 (option event move 11.6%) gives +0.48; the findings sum to +0.6 and the two agree in sign and size.
bar: Q3 2026 revenue consensus ~$38.8M (chartmill, https://www.chartmill.com/stock/quote/PONY/estimates, snippet_only, 403 on fetch) and $39.1M from 2 analysts (therighttrader, https://therighttrader.com/earnings-calendar/pony, snippet_only); EPS consensus -$0.17 (Zacks via AAII, 2 analysts, https://www.aaii.com/investingideas/article/534356-what-you-need-to-know-about-pony-ai-incs-q3-earnings, 2026-11-16) / -$0.18 (Yahoo, 2 analysts, range -0.19 to -0.17, snippet). Two sources agree on revenue to within $0.3M, but both rest on the same two analysts. Company guide: FY2026 robotaxi revenue >3.5x FY2025 ($16.6M => >=$58M), 'confident of exceeding' (Q2 release 2026-08-18, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001969302/000110465926098113/tm2623382d1_ex99-1.htm); fleet >3,500 by year-end. The market's real bar is probably the fleet count and the reiteration of both targets, not the revenue line.
positioning_check: Short interest ~23.6M shares, 5.4% of float, 8.1 days to cover as of 2026-10-07 (Equibles, https://equibles.com/stocks/pony/summary); 6.73% of float, 7.7 days as of 2026-04-30 (MarketBeat, https://www.marketbeat.com/stocks/NASDAQ/PONY/short-interest/). Not a crowded short. Baseline skew_25d is -9.63 vol points (25d calls richer than puts, 'upside paid'), put/call OI 0.14, ATM IV 145%, event implied move 11.59%. Tape: spot $3.915 at a 52-week low, -14.9% over 5 days, -25.9% over 20 days, -77.5% from the 52-week high; down 42.4% from the 2026-08-18 Q2 report to 2026-11-13 (AAII). The options market is leaning up into the print; the tape has been one-way down.

findings.finding: The company's own FY2026 guide implies an accelerating Q3 robotaxi line: FY2025 robotaxi revenue was $16.6M, the raised target is >3.5x (>= ~$58M), H1 2026 delivered $20.7M (Q1 $8.6M, Q2 $12.1M, +41% q/q), so H2 must deliver >= ~$37M (e.g. Q3 ~$16-17M, Q4 ~$21M), and on 2026-08-18 management said it was 'confident of exceeding' the target; with the other two segments flat at Q2's ~$24.1M, Q3 total revenue lands ~$40-41M against a ~$39M two-analyst consensus (about +3%).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 revenue $36.2M vs $35.2M estimate (Benzinga) and robotaxi +691%: HK shares fell >5% the next day and the US stock fell 42% from the report to 2026-11-13. Q4 2025 report (March 2026): -13.6% on the day. Q1 2026 (May): revenue $34.3M reportedly below a $51M estimate yet the stock rose ~3-4% on an EPS beat and a raised fleet/revenue target. Revenue beats alone have not been bought; raised targets have.
findings.why_not_priced: The arithmetic is inside a public guide, so the line itself is largely priced; what might not be is that the two-analyst $39M bar sits barely above Q2's $36.2M (+8% q/q) while the guide requires robotaxi alone to add ~$4-5M q/q. If the market had priced a ~$41M quarter the stock would not have set a new 52-week low into the print; it has instead fallen 15% in five sessions. The intelligent-solutions line (domain controllers, $10.8M in Q2, flat y/y after +384% product growth in Q1) is lumpy and could offset the robotaxi step-up either way.
findings.independence: FY2025 robotaxi base $16.6M from 36kr's write-up of the FY2025 release (https://www.36kr.com/p/3741065357964035, 2026-03-27); Q1 robotaxi $8.6M and the >3.5x raise from The Paper (https://www.thepaper.cn/newsDetail_forward_33237884, 2026-05-26). All are company-reported numbers; no independent series for Q3 robotaxi revenue was found.

findings.finding: The fleet count is the unknown the print reveals: 1,975 robotaxis at 2026-06-30 against a >3,500 year-end target means ~1,525 additions in H2 (vs ~1,000 added in H1), after a Chinese new-permit freeze from 2026-04-29 to ~2026-07-23 blocked fleet expansion, and the company has published no fleet milestone since the June figure, where it gave counts on 2026-03-25 (1,446) and 2026-05-24 (>1,700).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The one print with a raised fleet target (Q1 2026, 1,700 -> target 3,500) was the one print in 2026 the stock rose on (~+3-4%); the March 2026 print, where the 3,000 target was restated with 1,446 vehicles, fell 13.6%.
findings.source_date: 2026-09 (article refers to the 2026-09-10 Zagreb launch; no explicit date on page)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the drawdown since August is consistent with the market doubting the ramp. If the market believed the 3,500 target were safe, a name with $1.39B of liquidity and a raised revenue target would not be at a 52-week low with the Q2 report 42% behind it. The sign is genuinely open: a Q3 fleet near 2,600-2,800 with the target reiterated would be a positive; a figure near 2,200 or a softened target the negative. The absence of a fleet milestone press release is weak evidence (my search may have missed one) and is sized that way.
findings.independence: Permit freeze and resumption: The Star 2026-04-29 (https://www.thestar.com.my/tech/tech-news/2026/04/29/china-suspends-autonomous-driving-permits-after-baidu-outage) and 2026-07-24 (https://www.thestar.com.my/tech/tech-news/2026/07/24/china-resumes-issuing-robotaxi-licenses-after-long-freeze). Fleet 1,975 is also in the Q2 6-K exhibit (same document as finding 1 for that number).

findings.finding: Pony's Gen-7 lidar supplier Hesai reported Q3 2026 on 2026-11-10, after Pony last spoke, and its CFO said 'stronger shipments for robotaxis, robovans and humanoid robots' helped offset weaker lawnmower demand, with Hesai citing a 62% share of the global robotaxi lidar market; a counterparty read that robotaxi builds were up in Q3.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No history of this stock reacting to a supplier read-through found.
findings.why_not_priced: Hesai named no customer and gave no robotaxi volume, and its robotics lidar shipments reportedly fell ~36% q/q in Q3 overall, so the read-through is a proxy across Baidu, WeRide, Pony and others; PONY fell ~19% after this call, so the market did not treat it as Pony-specific. It is sized as a proxy.
findings.independence: Pony chose Hesai AT128 as the primary lidar for Gen-7 (Benzinga, April 2025, https://www.benzinga.com/trading-ideas/movers/25/04/45016167/pony-ai-shares-volatile-amid-strategic-tencent-partnership-and-hesai-lidar-integration-whats-going-on). Otherwise none.

findings.finding: Expectations and positioning going in are low and leaning up: the stock is at a 52-week low (-77% from high, -42% since the Q2 report, -15% in the five sessions before the print), 25d skew is -9.6 vol points (calls richer), put/call OI 0.14, and short interest is only ~5.4% of float (8.1 days, 2026-10-07), while sell-side targets still average ~$19.6 (MarketBeat, late Sep 2026) against a $3.92 spot.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After a -42% run between prints the Q1 2026 report (also at a then-52-week low in May) rose ~3-4%; the March 2026 report fell 13.6% from an already falling tape. No clean pattern.
findings.why_not_priced: This is the price itself, so by definition it is priced; it is filed because a judge needs it as the bar. The drawdown is only partly explained (sector sentiment after the Baidu outage, cash burn, the HK listing anniversary on 2026-11-06 when HK shares fell 8.4% to HK$34.80, >75% below the HK$139 offer, and broad growth-stock weakness on 2026-11-16), so a lower bar is real but not a reason by itself.
findings.independence: AAII 2026-11-16 (stock -42.4% from 2026-08-18 to 2026-11-13, https://www.aaii.com/investingideas/article/534356-what-you-need-to-know-about-pony-ai-incs-q3-earnings); Sina 2026-11-08 on the HK fall (https://finance.sina.cn/2026-11-08/detail-inixzapa7355914.d.html, snippet_only, 503 on fetch); short interest from Equibles (https://equibles.com/stocks/pony/summary).

findings.finding: Cash burn is rising with the fleet build: Q2 2026 non-GAAP free cash flow was -$76.2M, capex $32.2M (3.4x y/y), operating cash outflow $44.0M vs $25.4M a year earlier, liquidity $1,390.5M (from $1,435.5M), and the CFO has said 40,000-50,000 robotaxis are needed for free cash flow to turn positive; a Q3 with ~600+ vehicle additions likely shows a larger outflow.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Macquarie cut its target citing rising opex and cash burn after the March 2026 print (-13.6%); the Q2 print with -$76M FCF was followed by a steady decline.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced; the Earnings Whispers preview names cash burn as the focus. What the money buys is the fleet ramp that finding 2 needs, so a larger burn that comes with a larger fleet is a zero or a positive; only burn without the fleet is a negative. Liquidity of ~$1.39B against a market cap near $1.5-2B leaves no near-term funding question. Sized small for that reason.
findings.independence: Jiemian (https://m.jiemian.com/article/15098636.html) for the CFO's 40-50k-vehicle FCF breakeven remark; shares the Q2 6-K with finding 1.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Panabee 'Pony Q3 Revenue Rose 46%' page claiming Q3 2026 revenue $42.7M, gross margin 21.3%, 9M revenue $97.9M (-6%), named by the sweep as a possible pre-release
rejected_candidates.detail: The page is about 'Pony (PNYG)', a Guangdong-Hong Kong carpooling business, not Pony AI. Its numbers contradict Pony AI's own filings: H1 2026 revenue was $70.5M ($34.3M + $36.2M), so 9M revenue cannot be $97.9M 'down 6%' (Pony AI's 9M 2025 was ~$61M), and Q3 2025 was $25.4M, so +46% would be ~$37M, not $42.7M (Q2 2026 6-K, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001969302/000110465926098113/tm2623382d1_ex99-1.htm).

baseline_tension: The modest lean up agrees with the call-side skew and cuts against the one-way 20-day run-down; a name that has sold its last revenue beat and fallen 42% between prints is the reason the lean stays near 50.
lessons_applied: Lesson 1/6 (a verified fact is not a reaction; it lands inside the guide): the revenue-arithmetic finding was cut from +0.8 to +0.5 because it lands inside management's own FY robotaxi target and this name sold its Q2 revenue beat; p_up taken from 53 to 52.

Lesson 5 (an unexplained drawdown is worth 0; positioning and a two-analyst bar do not count as evidence): the positioning finding was cut from +0.5 to +0.3 rather than dropped (the core overrides 'do not file'), because the drawdown is only partly explained.
Lesson 5 (proxy sized small): the Hesai read-through was cut from +0.5 to +0.4 as a counterparty proxy that names no customer.
Lesson 4 (financing is a question): the cash-burn finding was left at -0.3 after asking what the money buys (the fleet ramp), and its text says so.
Lessons 7/8 left standing: short interest checked (5.4%, not crowded); no confirmed unpriced company-level number, so abs_move_pct stays at 12, not raised.
